notes.title: Speed Mazing - new game with local multiplayer
notes.content:
Infinite Dreams will be publishing [b]Speed Mazing[/b] - a small game with a huge amount of fun!
[b]Speed Mazing[/b] is a local multiplayer game for up to 4 players - perfect for a party or to play with your family! Hundreds of stages will keep you and your opponents entertained for a long time.
There's also a speedrunning mode for single player - a handful of carefully crafted stages with dozens of tricky corners to cut. Accompanied by a set of achievements to unlock.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29645849/95232abe950efc1cdc6b700d852eb80c7e77e4a2.png[/img]

Wishlist [b]Speed Mazing TODAY[/b] and look out for a demo during the Steam NEXT Fest in October!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1115400/Speed_Mazing/

notes.title: Cupcakes and evil Snowmen are back!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29645849/14bc2d13853cfef20003f23c2970b4615363d25e.png[/img]

It's that merry time of year, when cupcakes, cheesecakes and cream-cookies become war machines, and snowmen shoot their eye-lasers at you. All this, and more, only in [b]Sky Force Reloaded[/b]!
Get your gingerbread fighter jet and teach those baddies how to Christmas!
Our specially crafted Christmas Tournament stage is at your disposal through the Winter Holidays season. Make the best of it ("rescue" as much gifts as possible).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29645849/741a613cd097c7363216b68ca8eb85c8ee9eb1c9.png[/img]    [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29645849/741a613cd097c7363216b68ca8eb85c8ee9eb1c9.png[/img]    [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29645849/741a613cd097c7363216b68ca8eb85c8ee9eb1c9.png[/img]

Let us also use this opportunity to share a news with our VR-interested fans - we've got another game, completelty different from Sky Force, coming to Steam. [b]Let's Create! Pottery VR[/b] is our highly acclaimed pottery simulator. Leaving it's mobile roots and jumping straight into VR with quite a number of new features, [b]Let's Create! Pottery VR[/b] is the perfect relaxation game the let's you unleash your artistic creativity without the pain of having to clean up afterwards. check out our newly launches store page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/992610/Lets_Create_Pottery_VR/

notes.title: Improved support for ultrawide displays!
notes.content:
A new update for [b]Sky Force Reloaded[/b] is available. Support for 21:9 screen was improved quite a bit. All the UI, Main Menu and Stage selector now cover the whole screen. The gameplay area stays at it's previous dimensions, but the black bars have been replaced with slightly zoomed-in view of the main screen. The sides are darkened and show a bit retro, pixelated image. It's a similar approach many shmups take while being ported from arcades to widescreen.

[i]TECHNICAL NOTE: It's possible that after the update, your game will launch with incorrect resolution. Set the correct one in the options and then RESTART the game (exit and launch it again). Without it you may experience some graphical glitches on the sides of the screen.[/i]

Best regards,
Infinite Dreams.

notes.title: Stage B3 is now available!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29645849/1d5dae70e455643d5f712eb1a068eaf0de74abb2.png[/img]

Welcome, dear Pilots!
Today we're releasing the infamous [b]B3 Stage[/b] for all of you to enjoy, or to cry over...

This new stage sports a healthy amount of new weapons and enemies, followed by a formidable boss that will sneak upon you at least twice! 
Sadly, it is also the last stage we've had in plans for Sky Force Reloaded. We're quite happy it finally made it into the game, as the stage itself was "almost ready" since before we've even started the development of the Steam version (!).

Besides adding the new stage we've also inlcuded some translation corrections and changed the handling of inputs on some flight controllers (please report any strange new behaviour, if you encounter any).

Without further ado, get your planes up and rock that [b]B3[/b]!

notes.title: Soundtrack from Sky Force Reloaded released as a free DLC
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29645849/446da61b68a49eb256ef8c57c0212822c3380405.png[/img]By a popular demand (at least 5 people) we're releasing [b]Sky Force Reloaded[/b]'s Soundtrack. The album consists of 5 original tracks from 2006, 4 remastered versions and 2 new creations. A total of 11 tracks. As a treat for collectors, there's also a single *.MOD file containing all the original music.

Please enjoy this collection at no additional costs! You can get it here: 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/735270/Sky_Force_Reloaded__Original_Soundtrack/ or wait for the game to auto-update to the newest version.

Along with the soundtrack come several bug fixes and translation corrections.
More things to come soon!

notes.title: Amiga-esque shmup Sky Force Reloaded is out now
notes.content:
As a shmup aficionado, The Sky Force games have always sat on the periphery of my awareness. Despite Polish developers Infinite Dreams‘ origins working on Amiga games, their platform of choice for their flagship shmup series was the iPhone of all things. It seemed foolish, and I initially dismissed the original game as being entirely unsuited to the platform. I was wrong.

Against all odds, the genre flourished. Even Japanese bullet-hell monsters Cave began porting their arcade classics to phones and tablets, and the Sky Force series became one of the better-known mobile shooter franchises. Now, Infinite Dreams have come on home to PC with Sky Force Reloaded, and might just have a thing or two to teach us about accessibility in the genre.

(more…)

notes.title: Release date is set!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29645849/50ec3456323801d32c6c22c62a2443c625e0265a.png[/img]
[h1]Releases on [b]November 30th, 2017![/b][/h1]

It took us a little under forever to complete, but we've finally done it!
A huge THANKS to all our beta testers who've helped a lot with polishing the game to high gloss. Join us now in our anticipation and get ready for [i]THE[/i] shoot ‘em up you were looking for!
In addition to the features listed on our store page, we've got a healthy amount of trading cards, emoticons and beautiful profile backgrounds just waiting to be approved shortly after the game's release.
We're hoping all your patience will be handsomely rewarded in just a few more weeks, when the game gets released to the public!

notes.title: Closed Beta tests start today.
notes.content:
Today we've started beta tests of Sky Force Reloaded. Testers have been selected from the most devoted "Anniversary" players. We'll be now gathering feedback on game's performance, difficulty balance and new controller system integration.

Thanks to everyone who agreed to help us make this the best Sky Force Reloaded!
